description: This file contains internal command classes for updating task properties and statuses within the Superset framework, specifically for internal use with zero-read updates and race-safe status transitions.

classes.name: InternalUpdateTaskCommand
classes.description: Performs zero-read updates of task properties and payloads directly in the database for internal framework use.

classes.name: InternalStatusTransitionCommand
classes.description: Performs atomic, race-safe status transitions for tasks, used by executor code.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: No validation needed for internal command.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the update or status transition, returning True if successful.
